summary: Application monitoring platform that tracks errors, performance and releases.
access_note: Organization auth tokens via an internal integration; requires Manager or Admin org role.

evidence.quote: You can create authentication tokens within Sentry by creating an internal integration.
To use Sentry's APIs, you must have an authentication token.
The base MCP server address is: https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp
Pricing: Free Developer Plan, Pay as You Grow
OAuth2 for third-party applications that need to access Sentry on behalf of users

notes: Docs do not name a plan requirement; a free plan is assumed from general knowledge. REST not stated in a fetched sentence (inferred from Bearer header and endpoint docs). Sentry OAuth2 was added after the Composio auth cross-check; see the review entry.

review.reason: Sentry's own auth page, already cited here, describes OAuth2 with the authorization code grant. The first pass listed only API keys. Composio's Sentry toolkit also lists OAuth2.
